changes: Original HTML/CSS/JS are bundled inline for a no-same-origin sandbox. Restrictive CSP blocks external connections, frames and media.

Unverified 1GB/instant/no-crash tagline replaced with parser and in-memory-output limits. Optional ?sample=1 passes a synthetic 250-row File through the actual original parser. Default interface remains empty.
Demo correction: clear isFirstChunk after the first parsed header so later stream chunks retain every data row. Verified against synthetic multi-chunk input and the 250-row sample export.
Sandbox keyboard correction: Escape posts only the priyam-demo-close intent to the parent. The parent must verify event.source against the active iframe before closing.
Accessibility correction: the file drop area is a labelled keyboard button; Enter or Space invokes the original file input chooser, with a visible focus ring.

Visible native Use sample CSV button runs the same synthetic 250-row File-to-change-to-parser path as ?sample=1. Both upload and sample actions are labelled and keyboard accessible; updated metrics are announced politely. The upload drop area is a real block target without overlapping adjacent controls.
Mobile-only compatibility CSS at 600px and below preserves desktop styling while fitting the original controls and content within a phone viewport.
Publishing normalization: trailing whitespace removed; final newline normalized. No logic or layout change.
